 Advertisement Toyota is recalling more than 105,000 vehicles. Which models are affected
 Advertisement Updated: 11:08 AM EDT Oct 22, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Caitlyn Scott Digital Producer Toyota is recalling more than 105,000 vehicles. Which models are affected
 Updated: 11:08 AM EDT Oct 22, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Caitlyn Scott Digital Producer Toyota has issued a recall after it said some vehicles may have a faulty fuel tube that could result in a leak and fire risk. 
 Related video: How to stay ahead of recalls 
 Advertisement According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration , the company said 105,794 vehicles are being recalled over the potential issue. 
 Toyota said the vehicles have a faulty fuel tube connection near the fuel tank that may disconnect and leak fuel. A fuel leak paired with an ignition source can increase the risk of a fire, the car manufacturer said.
 The company said on Oct. 14 that "certain 2024-2027 Toyota Land Cruiser Hybrid vehicles" are affected. 
 NHTSA said car dealers will inspect the connection and "install a supplemental clamp or, as necessary, replace the resin fuel tube and install a supplemental clamp, free of charge."
 Owner notification letters are also expected to be mailed by Nov. 29, 2026. 
 To see if your vehicle is part of the recall, visit NHTSA's website here.
